# rweather Crypto 0.4.0 source provenance

The files in this directory are the minimal source closure selected from the
canonical PlatformIO package used by the firmware's pinned MeshCore library.

- Package: `rweather/Crypto@0.4.0`
- Canonical archive: `https://dl.registry.platformio.org/download/rweather/library/Crypto/0.4.0/Crypto-0.4.0.tar.gz`
- Archive SHA-256: `1867740aad0d61bdcbac25f6dbc8eefe6eed9e7b37f48d9d0b9d80500ad431e0`
- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/rweather/arduinolibs`

The WebAssembly target compiles AES-128, AES-256-GCM/GHASH, SHA-256/HMAC,
and Ed25519 verification support from this directory. No fork or similarly
named replacement is used.
